subject: Quick question on SaaS GTM Munich speaker slot
body:
Hi Julius,

I hope this email finds you well! Just a quick check-in regarding the upcoming Munich SaaS meetup. Could you please confirm if our planned fireside chat on the outbound-to-PLG transition is still set for the originally discussed time? 

Thanks so much!

Best,
Lena

events.reply:
Hi Lena,

thanks for reaching out! I'm travelling a lot and can't place this one right away. Which meetup is it exactly, and what date and time did you have in mind? Who was I talking to on your side when we discussed it? Send me the details and I'll check my calendar.

Best,
Julius
